prompt: I need a part that lets me fasten the end of a rotating shaft assembly to the flat face of a gearbox housing. The shaft has to pass straight through the middle with clearance, and the part needs to bolt down flat against the housing with several evenly spaced fasteners so the load is shared and it doesn't cock over when tightened. It should be stiff enough not to flex when the bolts are torqued. Please design something that does this.

judge.notes: Only the use case was described. Grade whether the design would serve that use; any geometry that works is correct.
